question.text: How often must the AMC update the SID?

answer.text: At least once every half-year (within one month from end of each half-year)
Only when the scheme is launched

explanation.text: The Logic: Subsequent SID updates are due within one month from the end of each half-year, based on data as at end-September and end-March. A separate rule applies during the initial launch period of a scheme, and material changes must be incorporated promptly. The Trap: The SID requirement is a half-yearly update, not an annual one, and is distinct from the KIM update rule. Monthly updates apply to other documents such as fact sheets, not to the SID. Note: Always verify the SID date to confirm you are referring to the latest version; an outdated SID may contain superseded information on loads, benchmarks, or fund managers.
